title: Stable Audio 3 provider runtime, provenance, supply-chain and current-host admission hardening
mandatory_outcomes: FA3-MUSIC-001 explicitly lists Stable Audio 3 alongside ACE-Step
Stable Audio 3 remains a replaceable provider and never an FA3 authority
audio-affecting runtime identity is immutable and provenance-bearing
Medium bf16 is retired and cannot be silently selected
TensorRT engine compute capability and chunking identity are recorded
Flash Attention production artifacts are immutable, hashed and provenanced
code, model and output-rights admission remain separate
current-host production promotion requires real execution evidence
